stem: Two models predict the number of subscribers, in thousands, to a streaming service \(t\) years from now. Model A predicts \(200 + 20t\) thousand subscribers, and Model B predicts \(200(1.1)^{t}\) thousand subscribers. How many thousand more subscribers does Model B predict than Model A for \(t = 2\)?
verify:
t = symbols('t')
A = 200 + 20*t
Bm = 200 * Rational(11, 10)**t
d = Bm.subs(t, 2) - A.subs(t, 2)
assert d == 2
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [d]
